svg.aria-label: How AstraZeneca's drug dollars flow — payers in, partners & CDMOs out
svg.text: How AstraZeneca's drug dollars flow — payers in, partners &
Government payers, insurers and patients pay ~$58.7B into AZN's four therapy areas; AZN then pays out R&D ($14.2B) and COGS — much
of which pools onto its alliance partner Daiichi Sankyo (Enhertu / Datroway), contract manufacturers, and a growing roster of China
money embedded in a finished chip
Source: AstraZeneca FY2025 results announcement (SEC 6-K, filed 2026-02-10) · FY2025 20-F · AZN China license-in press releases (CSPC 2026-01, Harbour 2025-03, Jacobio 2024-12, Eccogene 2023-11)
